events.title: Robin Mark Inspired Worship Night - Oak Bluff (Near Winnipeg)
events.time: 7:00 PM · Oak Bluff Bible Church, 53A MB-3, Oak Bluff, MB
events.description: A Night of Worship: The Songs of Robin Mark Join us for a special evening of worship as we celebrate the powerful music and ministry of Robin Mark, one of the most influential worship songwriters of our time. Best known for writing worship anthems such as "Days of Elijah," "Jesus, All for Jesus," "Revival," "The Wonder of the Cross," "When It's All Been Said and Done" and "Not by Might," Robin Mark's songs have inspired believers around the world to draw closer to God through heartfelt praise and worship. This uplifting night will feature many of Robin Mark's most loved songs, giving us the opportunity to sing together, reflect on God's faithfulness, and celebrate the hope we have in Christ. Whether these songs have been part of your worship journey for years or you are hearing them for the first time, this evening promises to be a meaningful time of praise, encouragement, and community. Come ready to lift your voice, worship with friends and family, and experience the joy of gathering around songs that have impacted churches across the globe. Together we'll revisit timeless favorites, share in God's presence, and proclaim His goodness through song. "These are the days of Elijah, declaring the Word of the Lord." All are welcome. Bring a friend and join us for an unforgettable evening of worship through the songs of Robin Mark. This special worship night is also a fundraiser in support of the 2027 Fun With Family Day Festival, whose theme is"Victory Over Darkness." Through worship, community, and outreach, the festival seeks to share the hope, light, and transforming love of Jesus Christ with individuals and families throughout our region. As we sing these powerful songs of faith, revival, and God's faithfulness, we are reminded that Christ has overcome the darkness of sin, fear, and despair. Every donation and act of support helps create opportunities to proclaim that message of hope beyond the walls of the church and into our community. Together, we can help create an event where families encounter encouragement, connection, and the life-changing truth that"the light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it." By supporting this fundraiser, you are investing in a ministry that seeks to point people to the ultimate victory found in Jesus Christ.

events.title: A Christmas Carol - Charles Dickens
events.time: 7:00 PM · Pembina Hills Arts Council, 352 Stephen Street, Morden, MB
events.description: Live Performance by John D. Huston 📅 Saturday, November 21, 2026 | 7:00 PM 📍 Pembina Hills Arts Council, 352 Stephen Street, Morden, MB 🎟️ $25/person Snacks provided! Enjoy a free cider generously sponsored by Dead Horse Cider. For the past thirty-five Decembers, veteran solo performer, John D. Huston has packed his trunk, grown his beard & trundled off to towns & cities recreating the tours & performances of Victorian author, Charles Dickens to full houses & standing ovations. “powerful one-man theatre…in the hands of a master storyteller.” The National Post Now in its 35th season Huston performs A Christmas Carol narrating & playing all the characters from Scrooge to Tiny Tim using a remarkable range of accents, & body language. His astonishing tour de force presentation has been acclaimed as “mesmerizing,” “powerful”, & “Christmas magic” by reviewers across the country. “A Christmas Carol a la Dickens” The Globe and Mail In this unique performance, the beloved story grows from the interplay of Dickens's richly-crafted text & Huston's bravura performance. "The audience & I share the story," Huston says, "they bring their memories of it, from movies, theatre, reading the book, even from seeing me in previous years. Together we create a memory, a new layer of the story as we revisit it together. Dickens asked his audiences to imagine they were assembled in a friend's house hearing the story told: I ask mine to do the same." “Vivid and lively...a consummate storyteller...mesmerising.” Winnipeg Free Press With over 800 performances behind him Huston has no plans to retire. "I'm still in love with this wonderful story & magnificent characters. Doing the show is like visiting old friends.” "I loved this production and urge all to see it." Ottawa Sun “Remarkable... Huston easily becomes the range of Dickens’ incredible characters.” The Hamilton Spectator John D. Huston presents Charles Dickens’ A Christmas Carol

events.title: Home Route Concert Series – Melissa Chilinski
events.time: 7:00 PM · Pembina Hills Arts Council, 352 Stephen Street, Morden, MB
events.description: 📅 Sunday, November 22, 2026 🕖 7:00–9:00 PM 📍 Pembina Hills Arts Council 🎟️ $25 per person Snacks provided! Drinks available for purchase. Join us for an evening of heartfelt folk, old-time, bluegrass, and country music with singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist Melissa Chilinski, joined by talented mandolin player Brielle Petrie on Melissa’s Home Routes tour. Originally from the Boston area and now based in Salt Lake City, Melissa brings a unique musical perspective shaped by her roots in traditional folk and old-time music, her background in soil science, and years spent working in agriculture and conservation. Blending clawhammer banjo, guitar, and heartfelt, jazz-inspired vocals, Melissa weaves stories of resilience, journey, and belonging into her original songs. Together, this talented duo will perform Melissa’s original songs alongside old-time, bluegrass, and country favourites, featuring energizing instrumentals, beautiful harmonies, and an intimate musical experience you won’t want to miss! ✨ Come enjoy a wonderful evening of live music, great company, and local arts!

events.description: International violin sensation and five-time Gospel Music Award winner Rosemary Siemens has performed four times at New York's Carnegie Hall, made history as the first violinist to perform at the Sistine Chapel at the Vatican, and taken the stage at the Grand Ole Opry. Together as SaxAndViolin, Rosemary and Eli will share the Christmas carols and beloved hymns you love, with Rosemary singing and playing violin, Eli on saxophone, and special family performances. Rosemary will also share inspiring stories from her international musical journey and the faith that has guided it. Bring your children, parents, grandparents, and friends. Come sing along, make Christmas memories together, and celebrate the birth of Jesus! CONCERT DETAILS Friday, December 4, 2026 Emmanuel Mennonite Church 750 Fifteenth Street Winkler, Manitoba, Canada 7 PM: Concert FREE admission. No tickets required. Limited seating. First come, first seated. A freewill offering will be received in support of Generation Rising's work with children in Latin America. ABOUT GENERATION RISING Presented by Generation Rising, a Christian organization helping children in Latin America build brighter futures through Christ-centered education. By partnering with local churches and schools, Generation Rising helps children break the cycle of poverty and create lasting change in their families and communities. events.title: Mark Humphries Orchestra Christmas Show
events.time: 2:00 PM · Manitou Opera House, 325 Main Street, Manitou, MB
events.description: Swing into the holiday season at the Manitou Opera House! Get into the Christmas spirit with an afternoon of festive music, big band swing, Christmas favourites and plenty of laughs when the Mark Humphries Orchestra takes the stage at the historic Manitou Opera House. From classic big band sounds to the holiday songs you know and love, this special Christmas performance promises an afternoon filled with music, memories and Christmas cheer. Whether you're a longtime fan of big band music or looking for a fun and festive way to celebrate the season, the Mark Humphries Orchestra is sure to put a swing in your Christmas step! Sunday, December 13, 2026 2:00 PM Doors open at 1:30 PM Manitou Opera House — Manitou, Manitoba About the Mark Humphries Orchestra Originally from Yorkshire, England, Mark Humphries comes from a family where music and entertainment run deep. His father, Dick Van Winkle, toured the world as a multi-instrumental comedic entertainer. Mark's own musical journey began at the age of 13 when his trumpet teacher invited him to sit in with a local swing band called Sounds 40. That early experience eventually led to performances with the UK's premier big band, the Syd Lawrence Orchestra. The original Mark Humphries Orchestra was formed in 1987 and toured throughout the United Kingdom until Mark and his wife, Jill, emigrated with their family to Western Manitoba in 2008. After settling in Manitoba, Mark returned to performing with the Brandon-based Scotty McIntosh Big Band. Following McIntosh's retirement, Mark took over as leader and reinvented the ensemble, bringing together talented musicians from Brandon University, Winnipeg, Shilo, Melita, Swan River and Saskatchewan. Today, Humphries proudly carries on the family tradition of combining music and comedy, bringing audiences the Canadian version of the Mark Humphries Orchestra. A Christmas Afternoon of Music & Laughter For this special Christmas performance, audiences can expect the orchestra to put its own swinging spin on the holiday season. Come enjoy an afternoon of: Big band swing Christmas favourites Classic music Mark Humphries' signature comedy A festive afternoon at the historic Manitou Opera House Bring your family, friends or fellow music lovers and swing into the holiday season with us!

Your admission is paid at the door and includes a beverage and snack, and all proceeds support the continued function of the Manitou Opera House. Whether you arrive in a gown, a blazer, or your favourite evening outfit, you’ll be right at home.
